canonical_project: Green Flare flare-gas Bitcoin mining data centres (3 sites)
notes: DCD (2025-06-02): Green Flare announced a 53 MW data centre programme for Bitcoin mining powered by flare gas, starting with three mining sites in Delta State totalling 53 MW. Crypto-mining data centres (not commercial colocation); announcement stage, no construction/permits confirmed. Capacity 53 MW is the announced site-load figure from trade press.
